description: Execute an explicitly requested native mcdev command in a developer-controlled project. Use mcdev_get_command for syntax and execution availability. args are exact argv tokens after the canonical command, not a shell string. Supports native metadata selectors, markets, validation hooks and native overwrite/deletion/auth-persistence effects. Supply explicit target/choices; no terminal interaction or automatic defaults. Deploy/runtime effects require the corresponding user request and ordinary host approval; no extra consent ritual. Diagnostics are bounded projections, not raw output. Completion is not independent remote verification; never automatically retry partial/unknown operations. Configure host timeouts for long operations; progress is emitted when requested.
name: run_mcdev_command
